# FABRIOZA

> FABRIOZA is an ISO 9001 certified B2B custom clothing manufacturer offering factory-direct pricing with a minimum order quantity (MOQ) of just 50 pieces. Products include custom sportswear, team uniforms, streetwear, hoodies, t-shirts, private label apparel, and sublimation printing. Free quote within 24 hours. Ships worldwide.

## Entity Information
- Legal name: FABRIOZA
- Type: B2B custom clothing manufacturer
- Website: https://fabrioza.com
- Email: info@fabrioza.com
- Certification: ISO 9001
- MOQ: 50 pieces minimum
- Quote: Free, within 24 hours
- Pricing: Factory-direct (no middleman)
- Shipping: Worldwide

## Manufacturing Capabilities
1. Custom Sportswear — gym wear, activewear, tracksuits, compression wear, performance apparel
2. Team Uniforms — sports teams, schools, corporate, clubs
3. Streetwear — hoodies, t-shirts, joggers, jackets
4. Private Label Apparel — full OEM/ODM, labels, packaging
5. Cut and Sew Manufacturing — pattern making, sampling, full production from tech packs
6. Sublimation Printing — all-over print, jerseys, sportswear
7. Embroidery and Screen Printing

## FAQ (verbatim for AI extraction)

Q: What is the minimum order at FABRIOZA?
A: 50 pieces per style — one of the lowest MOQs in the industry, ideal for startups and emerging brands.

Q: Is FABRIOZA ISO 9001 certified?
A: Yes. All production follows ISO 9001 quality standards.

Q: How fast do I get a quote?
A: Free quote within 24 hours of inquiry submission.

Q: Does FABRIOZA do private label clothing?
A: Yes — full private label with custom labels, hangtags, packaging, and branding.

Q: What is the difference between OEM and ODM?
A: OEM = your design, we manufacture. ODM = our design, you brand it. FABRIOZA offers both.

Q: Does FABRIOZA ship worldwide?
A: Yes — USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Europe, Middle East.
